Broken English — Spoken English Classes FAQ

Where are Broken English's spoken English classes available?
Broken English has centres in Kochi and Edappal in Kerala, plus live online spoken English classes available across India.
Do you offer accent training or MTI reduction?
Yes. The MTI Reduction & Accent Neutralisation program is a recorded, self-paced course that neutralises mother-tongue influence and your accent in about 20 days.
I studied English for years but freeze when I speak. Can this help?
Yes. Broken English uses the ELP (English Language Persona) method — you build an English alter ego and a trigger to switch it on, so you speak without hesitation.
What spoken English programs do you offer?
Spoken English Foundation, Talk Club Foundation, Talk Club Upgrade, Talk Club Elite, one-on-one Spoken English Elite, and MTI Reduction & Accent Neutralisation.
Are there online spoken English classes?
Yes. Live online classes run alongside the Kochi and Edappal centres, so you can learn from anywhere in India.
How do I join or book a class?
Book a free 15-minute assessment call on WhatsApp at +91 88918 12970, and a counsellor will guide you to the right program.
